body:
## Summary
Local Docker-based test execution (`just test`) takes ~3m 42s due to redundant downloads, un-idempotent compilation, and full Homebrew provisioning. Additionally, `just test` fails when run from linked Git worktrees (#189) due to broken `.git` pointer resolution and Git safe-directory restrictions. This specification defines optimizations to reduce local test runtime to ~24s–36s (6x–9x speedup) while preserving test integrity, providing safeguards for full clean-state testing, and fixing linked Git worktree test execution.

## Motivation / Context
Running `just test` locally took 3m 41.7s (92.8% of time spent in Ansible provisioning):
1. Ephemeral container re-installed Homebrew on Linux from scratch + 27 formulae + gcc (~89s), none of which are asserted by `goss.yaml` or Bats integration tests.
2. `mise install` re-downloaded runtimes (node, go, ruby), 18 global npm packages, and compiled Ruby native gems without volume caching (~41s).
3. `apt` ran an unconditional `update_cache: true` for missing Linux prereqs (~26s).
4. `roles/dotfiles/tasks/nvim.yml` checked a nonexistent path (`creates: "{{ dotfiles_home }}/dev/go/bin/gopls"`) instead of `which gopls` / `$GOBIN`, forcing `gopls` recompilation from source on every single test run (~15s).
5. Linked Git worktree test execution (#189): Running `just test` from a linked worktree (e.g., under `.worktrees/`) failed at `dotfiles : Clone TPM` with `fatal: not a git repository`. In linked worktrees, `.git` is a pointer file referencing the common git directory (`<main-repo>/.git/worktrees/...`). Because the container only mounted `.:/dotfiles`, Git inside the container could not resolve the host's common git directory and threw fatal errors.

Profiling confirmed RAM was not the bottleneck (peak container RAM ~1.06GB on host with 8GB free; no swap activity), but burst CPU and network I/O were heavily saturated.

## Requirements
- Optimize local inner-loop `just test` to finish in under 45 seconds (target ~25s–35s).
- Fix `gopls` idempotency check in `roles/dotfiles/tasks/nvim.yml` to check actual binary existence (`which gopls`).
- Add `cache_valid_time: 86400` to `roles/dotfiles/tasks/prereqs.yml` apt task.
- Mount persistent `.ci-cache/` volumes in `docker-compose.yml` for mise runtimes/cache, tmux plugins, and go/coc.
- Set default `DOTFILES_ANSIBLE_EXTRA_ARGS: "--skip-tags brew,rust"` in `docker-compose.yml` (matching GitHub Actions CI behavior in `ubuntu-tests.yml`).
- Add fast syntax check (`ansible-playbook --syntax-check`) to `just test-unit` to guard against regressions in skipped roles (`brew.yml`, `rust.yml`).
- Add dedicated `just test-clean` recipe to `justfile` that wipes `.ci-cache/` and executes a full cold test without `--skip-tags`.
- Support linked Git worktrees (#189):
  - In `justfile`, resolve common Git directory (`git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`) and bind-mount it read-only into Docker container (`test`, `test-clean`, `dev`).
  - Configure `safe.directory: "*"` in Docker container environment ([docker-compose.yml](file:///home/tribou/dotfiles/docker-compose.yml) and [Dockerfile](file:///home/tribou/dotfiles/Dockerfile)) to allow cross-UID / worktree access without dubious-ownership errors.
- Docker build hygiene: Add `.worktrees/`, `.claude/`, and `.ci-cache/` to `.dockerignore` to prevent child worktree trees from inflating Docker build context.

## Non-goals
- Rewriting Docker base image to bake in all user runtimes (maintains flexibility for local dotfile hacking).
- Modifying remote CI workflows beyond aligning flags (GitHub Actions already skips brew).
- Changing dotfiles installation logic on macOS hosts.

## Testing
- Verify all 54 Goss infrastructure assertions pass in `just test`.
- Verify all 25 Bats integration tests pass in `just test`.
- Verify `just test-unit` includes syntax validation across all Ansible task files.
- Verify `just test-clean` successfully clears `.ci-cache/` and runs a full cold-start bootstrap.
- Verify `just test` passes when executed from both primary checkout and linked worktree (`.worktrees/`).
- Benchmark and verify runtime drops from ~3m 42s to ~25s–35s on cached runs.

## Open decisions
none

<details>
<summary>Brainstorm log</summary>

- [x] Q: What are the primary bottlenecks and is RAM competing? A: RAM is not constrained (peak 1.06GB / 8GB free). Bottlenecks are Homebrew download/compile (89s), uncached mise runtimes/gems (41s), uncached apt update (26s), and gopls recompilation bug (15s).
- [x] Q: How do Tier 1 fixes compromise test integrity and are we comfortable accepting the risk? A: Integrity risk is low and acceptable: gopls and apt fixes are pure idempotency bugfixes; brew/rust skipping matches existing GitHub Actions CI (goss/bats don't test brew packages; syntax check in test-unit provides safety); volume caching shifts local runs to idempotent convergence, which matches existing `.ci-cache/nvim` precedent and can be wiped on demand.
- [x] Q: For the clean-state fallback safeguard, how should cold-start testing be triggered? A: Dedicated `just test-clean` recipe that clears `.ci-cache/` and runs without `--skip-tags`.
- [x] Q: Can we fold in the fixes for Issue #189 (Docker suite failing in linked Git worktrees)? A: Yes. Fold in dynamic common git dir mount in justfile and safe.directory: '*' container configuration so just test works seamlessly in worktrees.
- [x] Q: Will this prevent accidentally running tests inside child worktrees, or has that been an issue? A: It has not been an issue because Bats and Goss runners use explicit non-recursive paths (tests/*.bats, tests/integration/), so tests inside child worktrees are never accidentally run from the parent. Rather, the fix enables intentionally running tests from inside a child worktree (which previously broke). Additionally, adding .worktrees/, .claude/, and .ci-cache/ to .dockerignore prevents worktree files from entering Docker build contexts.

</details>
title: perf(test): docker-based tests running very slow locally
